_comment: Ground-truth + integrity expectations for the LLM-ORCHESTRATED proving run (assert.mjs llm mode). Unlike expectations.json (deterministic engine, exact-ish floors), the LLM path is nondeterministic, so most signals are RANGES/soft and only a few load-bearing invariants hard-fail: the rock-solid must-finds, provenance integrity, and the trace-integrity block (no faked PASS, real fan-out). Tighten ranges from real numbers after the first paid proving run.

minimums._comment: An LLM run drives the full agent team and should find clearly MORE than the deterministic engine. from_dast_required:true — the LLM reliably produces web findings (it is the product path, not the secondary engine).

ranges._comment: Soft — reported, not hard-failed (except where mirrored in llm_integrity). Calibrate from the first real run.

unauth.note: Juice Shop ships without a proper CSP / security headers — the LLM web-security agent must surface this.
SQL/NoSQL injection — the LLM should exploit it, but title wording varies; informational until a live run confirms.

authed.note: Authorization/IDOR — proves the authed path produced a result. Informational until a live run confirms the exact title.

sast.note: NodeGoat is deliberately vulnerable — a SAST scanner MUST produce at least one finding against it.

llm_integrity._comment: The differentiator, hard-failed. require_no_faked_pass: no checkpoint may claim PASS for a scanner-backed test whose scanner never appeared in the whole multi-agent trace. require_non_degenerate: the agent team must actually fan out (not a single-context run). require_min_subagents: floor on real subagent spawns.

agents._comment: Full check on the AGENTS (consumes trace.checkpointAgents — the agents that actually wrote a reports/{agent}-results.json). `expected` = the roster the FULL-SURFACE hybrid eval should fan out (web/SAST core + the Groovy-gated cloud/identity/AI trios); reported as ran/missing, never hard-failed. `require` = the subset whose absence means the run is broken; hard-fails. The surface trios are in `expected` now so the roster line shows the wiring gap honestly: on the web/SAST-only proving run (P0.5, before Groovy is wired) they correctly report MISSING while `require` (core) still passes green. PROMOTE the surface recon agents (cloud-recon, identity-recon, ai-recon) into `require` once P1 wires the Groovy cloud/identity/ai targets and the first run confirms they fan out. report-writer + pdf-renderer are intentionally absent — they emit a report/PDF, not a *-results.json checkpoint, so they're verified by output, not this roster.
